explanation.en:
どう means “how.” It is used to ask about manner, condition, or opinion. It can also be used to ask “how is it?” or “how do you do it?”

Key points:
• どう + Verb = how (do something)
• どうですか = how is it?
• どうやって = how to do (more specific)
• Common in daily conversation

Example: “どう行きますか” means “How will you go?” “この映画はどうですか” means “How is this movie?”

It is a very flexible question word. Use it to ask about feelings, health, or methods.

Practice with simple questions: どうしますか, どうやって作りますか.

structure.pattern: どう + Verb / どうですか

examples.japanese: この映画はどうですか。
examples.romaji: Kono eiga wa dou desu ka.

examples.japanese: どうやって来ましたか。

commonMistakes.mistake: Using どう with time questions
commonMistakes.example: ❌ どう行きますか (meaning when) → ✅ いつ行きますか

commonMistakes.correction: Add か to make it a question
commonMistakes.example: ❌ この映画はどうです → ✅ この映画はどうですか
